utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Sunday at the community center? It's from 10 to 2, and they fix all sorts of things!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Wait, I thought it was from Leo's news on the date... Pia mentioned Saturday, so I'm a bit mixed up now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I think there's been some confusion—Opal confirmed it's actually Sunday at the community center parking lot, from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Right, fixing bikes for kids! I think I remember something about that... when is it again?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's this Saturday, at the community center. I heard they're fixing up all sorts of stuff, not just bikes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday! Right, I wrote it down somewhere... oh, I think it's on a sticky note on my fridge. Or was that my grocery list? I'll still try to make it!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Faye, Jules mentioned you're coordinating with the school for the repair drive—how's that going?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We're making progress! Still waiting on a few responses, but Leo's in for the morning shift.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great to hear! I'll be there with my old lamp—hope someone can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I hope it goes well for everyone, but I think I'll still have to pass.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, that's too bad, Uli. Maybe next time, then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, maybe next time. Take care.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, do we have a fixed time for the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You really think they'll actually show up on time? What's the supposed schedule?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We need to set a concrete start time, otherwise people will be all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey there! I've got a van full of tools for the repair drive—need anything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey, that's great. I might swing by if I get off work early—got a wonky blender.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A blender? I've fixed a few of those—bring it by and we'll get it whirring again!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a start, though. Even a little helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: True! Say, Rey, are you free to come by on Saturday? We could use another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think I can make it on Saturday. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Opal, just heard the repair drive's moved to Sunday at the community center. Same time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that's right! It's in the community center parking lot from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, do we really have enough volunteers and parts to fix all the bikes? I'm worried one drive might not be enough.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I understand your worry, but we have a great team and I've secured extra parts. Plus, moving it to the community center gives us more space to work.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's reassuring, Rosa, but do you really think we can handle all the heavy repairs in just one day?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, just a reminder about the repair drive this Saturday - we're fixing bikes for kids at the community center. Meet at my garage at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, bikes! Thanks Vik, I had it mixed up with fences again. See you Saturday at 9!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you then! And don't forget to bring any spare parts you might have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're patching up fences and bikes around the neighborhood. Still trying to round up tarps and rope—got any leads?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I already asked Gus if he has any in his van. Want me to check with him again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Tess, about the rope—is that for something at the repair drive, or did I get confused?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh no, no rope needed! The repair drive is just for fixing electronics and small appliances like my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, that's a relief! So no fence post rope required. I'll bring my broken blender then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, just reminding you about the repair drive this Saturday—we're fixing bikes for kids at the community center. Meet at my garage at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Vik, Rosa just told me it's moved to Sunday at the community center, 10-2.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, I thought we confirmed Saturday at my garage! Let me check with the others.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Noah! The repair drive? I think I forgot the details again...

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it's the bike repair drive for kids, I think. At least that's what I remember.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Bikes for kids? That sounds wonderful. But when and where is it again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I might stop by if I have time. Got a broken lamp.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great! I'm just waiting on Leo to confirm the date, but I'll let you know once it's set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, just shoot me a message when you hear back from Leo.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll wait for Jules to clarify before deciding what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, Hana, it's actually this Sunday from 10 to 2 at the community center parking lot. I think they accept electronics, small appliances, and maybe fence posts? Let me double-check with Opal.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks Jules, I'll wait until you hear back from Opal before I start gathering things.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? I heard Gus is bringing a van full of tools!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm planning to come. Should I bring my own broken things to fix?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, bring whatever you've got! I think Tess is bringing a toaster, so the more the merrier.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Morning, Opal. Vik's organizing a repair drive this Saturday—we're fixing up old bikes for the kids at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Dane, I think there's been a mix-up. I just confirmed with Eli that it's actually this Sunday, same place, 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, my mistake—Sunday works better anyway. Thanks for the heads-up, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, I've been asking around for extra tarps and rope for the repair drive. Mara said her neighbor Sam might have some gear. Do you know anyone else who could help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not sure about supplies, Cleo. Faye still hasn't set a start time, so maybe check with her on what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good point, I'll check with Faye about the timing and what else we might need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, heard you're helping with the repair drive—I've got a van full of tools if you need anything!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus! That van full of tools is exactly what we need. I'm just checking on tarps for Cleo's roof, but everything's coming together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Tarps? I’ve got a few in the van, along with some rope and bungee cords. Want me to bring 'em over?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I hope the repair drive goes well.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli! That's sweet of you. We'll miss you, but hopefully next time!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Take care, Rosa. I'll try to make the next one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It's this Saturday at 9 AM at Vik's garage — we're fixing up bikes for kids at the community center, though I'm worried we might not have enough volunteers to handle everything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is there a sign-up sheet for volunteers? I can help if needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually falling for that? You really think they'll fix your toaster for free?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Kira, it's legit! The community center's been organizing these for years. My neighbor Eli is helping out, and they fixed his blender last time!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, Jules mentioned you were checking with the PTA about the repair drive schedule—any luck with that?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, Ira. I left a message with the PTA secretary, but I'm still waiting to hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Ah, got it. Let me know if you need me to follow up or ask around—I'll be at the store all afternoon.
